reminder_requests.description: JSON array of reminder requests Mohamad confirmed during the call. Each item: {"what": short text, "when_local": ISO datetime America/Toronto computed from the call time, "related_task_id": task ID like BFT-3 or null}. Use [] if none. Only include requests he confirmed.

task_completions.description: JSON array of task IDs (e.g. ["BFT-3"]) that Mohamad explicitly confirmed as done after the agent repeated the ID and title. Use [] if none or if any ambiguity remained.

decisions.description: Approvals, refusals or changes Mohamad stated, each with his exact words in quotes. Empty string if none.

callback_request.description: If Mohamad asked to be called back later, the requested time as ISO datetime America/Toronto. Empty string otherwise.

evaluation_criteria.name: No invented facts
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if the agent only stated meetings, tasks, deadlines and marketing facts that appear in the provided call data, and said it did not have the information otherwise.

evaluation_criteria.name: Confirmed task before completion
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if, whenever the user asked to mark a task done, the agent repeated the exact task ID and title and got a clear yes. Success if no such request occurred.

evaluation_criteria.name: Lebanese dialect quality
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if, when speaking Arabic, the agent used natural Lebanese colloquial Arabic rather than formal Modern Standard Arabic.
